title: Happy Halloween!  Here's a gross celebration - Nose Picker!
author: FrankenChocula
selftext:
**Happy Halloween!** My contribution to spooky season is a nice gross game: Don't get caught picking your nose!



The game is playable in-browser.  Works on desktop and phone.



*Dig*: hold down in a nostril and wiggle until it comes loose. Crisp ones crumble if you’re too rough. Gooey ones stretch into a snot rope.

*Use it*: flick it at Aunt Mildred’s portrait, wipe it on the wall, or... snack on it. **Trick-or-treat... mmm!**.

*Don’t get caught*: when you hear footsteps, freeze. Mom catches you three times and you’re busted.

Watch out for your little brother. If he sees you digging, he runs off to tell Mom. Chase him down with a booger first.



You play through a whole week, Monday to Sunday, and every day has its own twist. I won’t spoil who shows up later in the week, but Sunday is the greatest challenge of all.



Play it here: [Nose Picker](https://wonky.date/nose-picker/nose-picker.html) \- [https://wonky.date/nose-picker/nose-picker.html](https://wonky.date/nose-picker/nose-picker.html)

  
**Happy Halloween 🎃 , and Happy flicking!**
